title: How To License The OpenStack Expertise Logo
body:
Sponsorship Requirements:

This program requires your company to be a Platinum, Gold, Silver, or Associate Member of the OpenInfra Foundation. To become a Member of the OpenInfra Foundation, see openinfra.dev/join/members.

Technical Requirement Summary for Those Providing Expertise:

  • Licensee must be well versed in OpenStack software, possessing in-depth knowledge of its features, functions, and capabilities.
  • Licensee must assist clients in one or more of several ways, namely, with installation, configuration, and customization of the software; providing technical support; and/or providing guidance on how to use the software to achieve specific business objectives.
  • Licensee must clearly state which OpenStack projects and versions are used to set customer expectations.

Technical Requirement Summary for Those Providing Training:

  • A primary goal of the training program is training students to contribute to OpenStack software, operate an OpenStack cloud, or build applications for OpenStack clouds;
  • Training program curriculum must provide a strong understanding of OpenStack Core, based on a current version of the software from either of the latest two releases and associated milestones;
  • Training program curriculum must cover OpenStack community structure, governance and contribution process; and
  • Licensee must clearly state which OpenStack projects and versions are used to set customer expectations.
